findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_providers, request_research, get_research, get_provider · Private data: request_research, get_research, get_group_fair_price, get_price_index_history, create_custom_benchmark, get_custom_benchmark, delete_custom_benchmark · Public sink: request_research, refine_results, get_group_fair_price, report_outcome · Destructive: research_capability, request_research, create_custom_benchmark, update_custom_benchmark, delete_custom_benchmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_providers, request_research, get_research, get_provider · Private data: request_research, get_research, get_group_fair_price, get_price_index_history, create_custom_benchmark, get_custom_benchmark, delete_custom_benchmark · Public sink: request_research, refine_results, get_group_fair_price, report_outcome · Destructive: research_capability, request_research, create_custom_benchmark, update_custom_benchmark, delete_custom_benchmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
